about.title: Faade
about.intro: {project} ko platform lonndital fiilji peer-to-peer jamaanu hesu mo mahaa e dow ñeeñal hesêre laaɓe. O denndinii interface huutorɗo newiiɗo e arkitektir laaɓe timmuɗe, hokkit safara hisuɗo e gomɗinaaɗo ngam lonndital data ko nge ndeɓɓa-ki dow nokkuure hakkunde fof. Projet on ko open source kadi o saakaa e ley {license}.

decentralized.title: Reso laaɓe timmuɗe
decentralized.description: Alaa serweer hakkundal, alaa noddi gootiri tampere. Huutorɓe ngheɓa kuule ɗen e aawta ɗum'en hakkunde maɓɓe tigi, ɗum nde ndeɓɓa-ki dow eɓɓinooji hakkundal, raddooji walla baasi data.

accessControl.title: Kontoroolol naatirde laaɓɗol
accessControl.description: Kala neɗɗo o joom-fitam ngam fuɗɗude reso muuɗum bana laawi muuɗum. Ñeeño dewwa huutorɓe e nder kala reso: jeyɗum, admin, jaltinooɗo, mooderateer e jaawtinɗo. Hawre laaɓɗol mo wawi jaltinde, mooderate e jaawtude kuule.

ui.title: Interface huutorɗo daraja toowɗo
ui.description: Interface naɓdi diftaareeji laaɓɗo e newɗo huutorɓe mo mahaa ngam platforms desktop, TV e portable. Yaha e laawol-laawol e klaviyer, kuusu, gamepad walla kontoroolol cuuɗiingu. Huutorɓe yawti baawɗi tafa interface gollirgal ngam yahnirde softiweer bana serweer fiilji aldaa hoore.

dataFormat.title: Mbaadi data njanngotaaɗi e neɗɗo
dataFormat.description: Mbaadi data LISH ko mahaa e dow JSON, ɗum waɗi nde no newii sosude, taro e faamde. Lonndoɗii kuule maa e meta-data laaɓɗum e cuwlam, mo kala neɗɗo wawa lewɓinde e newɗam.

security.title: Sirru e kisal
security.description: Kala jokondire peer-to-peer ko cuusiraaɗe, ɗum hawre wonde data maa wona e sirru e nder ndegoye. Huutorɓe e mbaawi suuɗaade caggal VPN ngam tappire ɓesngu nokkuwol kadi nde ngu nokku ɓe wawee. {project} hettira sirru maa e nder maaɗagol.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Softiweer no woodi e platforms Windows, Linux e macOS. Huutoro e kala kaɓirgol mo njiɗ ɗaa.

download.title: Aawtaade
download.description: Hebu {project} ngam platform maa. Kala kaawtaaɗi ko meeɗen e open source.
